recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. The seed issue was historically applied and the current specification still reflects the WG-approved patient element name; no follow-up source work is needed.
issue_request: FHIR-5400 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Patient Care Jan 2015 ballot comment for AllergyIntolerance. It asked to resolve the inconsistent use of "subject" versus "patient" for a Patient reference; the final disposition said naming rules make this "patient" unless there are strong business reasons otherwise.
initial_application: The Jira comments record "svn revision 4397". Local git history contains the corresponding git-svn commit abfa3dc8a71b155e9d632bc592bffb6bf02a4b08, titled "#5400 - rename AllergyIntolerance.subject to allergyintolerance.patient" with git-svn-id build@4397. The patch changed the historical AllergyIntolerance spreadsheet from AllergyIntolerance.subject to AllergyIntolerance.patient and updated examples, profiles, compartments, and generated Java model files.
additional_context: FHIR-3700 is an earlier Published/Persuasive issue for the same AllergyIntolerance rename, based on the rule to use "patient" when the only target is Patient. Later FHIR-39070 clarified the short display for AllergyIntolerance.patient and has already been reconciled on the combined branch. AllergyIntolerance remains an active Patient Care resource in source/fhir.ini, so the current StructureDefinition and search-parameter bundle are in build scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already defines AllergyIntolerance.patient as a required Reference(Patient), the AllergyIntolerance-patient SearchParameter uses AllergyIntolerance.patient, and exact source searches found no current AllergyIntolerance.subject element or search-parameter remnants in the active AllergyIntolerance sources.
